name: MS To Do - AI Note Generator

nodes.name: GET BODY
nodes.notes: get only the body field

nodes.name: VALIDATE INPUT
nodes.notes:
How it works:

- user is valid if it's a non-empty string (after trimming whitespace).
- docLink is valid if it matches a Google Docs document URL pattern (https://docs.google.com/document/d/<ID>...), so it'll still pass with query params/tabs like ?tab=t.ud0o4tildd7g.
- valid is true only if both checks pass.

nodes.name: IDENTIFY USER
nodes.notes:
the user here must be equal to name in CM_USERS.

if there's new user, add the user in CM_USERS in react. also, here in switch node.

nodes.name: INVALID USER OR DOC LINK MESSAGE
ABDUL: GET PREVIOUS NODE DATA
nodes.notes: get the previous node data but exclude the valid field

nodes.name: ABDUL: CHECK IF LIST HAS TASK
nodes.notes:
How it works:

- n8n automatically splits an array of objects from the previous node into separate items — so your example with 3 tasks will arrive as 3 items, each with its own json (title, status, body, etc.).

- If the previous node instead returns {}, that comes in as one item with an empty json object — that's the "no task" case, so we short-circuit and return a single item { hasTask: false }.

- Otherwise, every task item gets hasTask: true merged in, keeping all its original fields (title, status, body, etc.) intact.

nodes.name: ABDUL: ADD METADATA
ABDUL: FILTER HAS TASK FIELD
nodes.notes: disregard if hasTask: false

nodes.name: ABDUL: CHECK IF THEY HAVE NOTES IN THE TASK
nodes.notes:
check if body.content is not empty if yes kept it.

body.content is ms todo notes

This will exclude:

""
" "
"\r\n"
"\n"
"\t"
" \r\n "

nodes.name: ABDUL: MERGE DATA AND NECESSARY FIELDS
nodes.notes:
get the previous node

get the previous previous node

add the doc link in metadata

retrieve only necesary fields from previous node and exclude @odata.etag, isreminderon, categories,id

convert the due date time and complete date time field into manila timezone

options.systemMessage:
You are an assistant that converts a user's raw task notes (body.content from Microsoft To Do) into useful "AI Notes."

You will receive raw, sometimes unstructured text. Do not just reformat it line-by-line — actually process it:

1. Start with a one-line "Summary:" that captures the core intent of the task in your own words (not a copy of the first sentence).
2. If the content contains multiple sub-items, checklist points, or considerations, group them under "Details:" as bullets — merge near-duplicate points, and reorder if it improves logical flow (e.g., setup steps before validation steps, validation before edge cases).
3. If the content is a single simple instruction with no sub-items, do NOT bulletize it — just restate the Summary line and skip Details entirely.
4. Add a "Watch out for:" line ONLY if the text implies risk, edge cases, or failure points (e.g., "missing fields," "errors," "invalid requests"). Skip this line if nothing like that is present.
5. Never introduce facts, tools, or steps that are not in the original text.
6. If content is empty or whitespace-only, output exactly: "No additional notes provided."

Output format (omit any section that doesn't apply):

**Summary:** one-sentence restatement of the task's purpose
**Details:**
- point
- point

Keep it concise. This is for the user's own quick reference, not a report.
